rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: Addressing members of the Working Committee and the AICC at Talkatora Stadium, the speaker says 'A few days ago, I submitted my resignation to the Congress Working Committee' and that 'If today I stand before you, there is only one reason for this': over nine days her workers gave her 'the reassurance without which my assuming the post of President would have been without purpose'. Only the INC's title calls the speech a withdrawal of resignation.
